content.title: Graco recalls car seats sold at Target, Walmart
content.text: Skip to content(Gray News) - Graco is recalling some of its car seats.The issue involves the base of the Snug-Ride Turn and Slide infant car seats.The affected car seats were sold at Amazon, Babylist, Target, Walmart and on GracoBaby.com.Graco said the company discovered “a structural issue” during post-production testing, but did not further specify what the problem is. The car seats are still safe to use without the base, according to Graco.Owners of the car seats can contact Graco for a free replacement base.Copyright 2026 Gray Local Media, Inc.
